title: Split generate_study_materials.sh under the 250-line cap with tested libs
objective: Bring linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/utils/generate_study_materials.sh from 1017 lines under the repo-wide 250-line cap by moving its functions and its 335-line top-level block into six sourced libraries, without changing the output it produces for any input it previously handled correctly. File 2 of the Phase 1 queue.
acceptance_criteria: The entry script and every lib/study_*.sh and lib/tests/*.sh file is at or under 250 lines.
All three generated files stay byte-identical to a golden fixture captured before any edit, verified by sha256sum after every step.
verify_shell_split.sh against 08f3c764 reports no function whose body changed; additions are limited to the wrappers introduced around previously top-level code.
shell_coverage.sh reports 100% for every lib, or a measured figure with a falsified diagnosis for any shortfall.
Any latent defect the tests expose is fixed rather than pinned, and each fix is demonstrated on a fixture that actually triggers it.
shellcheck reports zero findings with no suppression added.
out_of_scope: Changing which documentation sites the URL builders point at.
Reworking the per-language analysis mode, beyond covering it with tests.
The other five files still over the cap.
verifier: sha256sum -c against the golden fixture plus a stdout diff, bash meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh 08f3c764, lib/tests/run_all.sh (166 assertions), bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage.sh lib/tests/run_all.sh <lib> 100 for all six libs, a second fixture with 25 imports and comment lines run at --top 3, shellcheck, and check_file_length.sh --all.
